steps.path: Any theme page → the heart in the top card (here: Meadow Mist)
steps.headline: Four ways to draw the like button. Which should theme pages use?
steps.notice: All four use the app's normal buttons. Liked fills the heart in the accent colour; in 'Filled when liked' the whole button fills.
steps.risk: In the narrow right column the heart sits beside the chips, so the author and downloads chips get cut short by the fade.

variants.label: Plain heart
variants.summary: Heart and count with no outline, like the star and share beside it (round 2).

variants.label: Outlined
variants.summary: Heart and count inside an outlined button, so it reads as something to press.

variants.label: Filled when liked
variants.summary: An outlined 'Like 88' button that fills with the accent once you've liked it, reading 'Liked'.
variants.risk: The widest of the four; the chips have least room.

variants.label: Heart, count as chip
variants.summary: Just a heart icon; the number moves into the chip row as '88 likes'.
variants.risk: The chip's number doesn't change the moment you like it — only after the page refreshes its counts.

steps.path: Marketplace → Connect your stuff → Google Workspace
steps.headline: Three ways to show an integration's icon, two of them with a tighter top card. Which do you prefer?
steps.notice: In the tighter cards the description and the Uninstall / Connect buttons share one line, so the card is about a third shorter.

variants.label: Big tile
variants.summary: Round 2: the coloured 'G' square beside the name, roomy card.

variants.label: Small badge
variants.summary: A small coloured 'G' just before the name, about the size of the provider logos in the model picker; tighter card.

variants.label: No icon
variants.summary: Just the name and its status pill; tighter card.
variants.risk: Integrations lose their colour on this page.

steps.headline: The theme page you picked: the picture on the left with no 'Preview' label, the top card and colours on the right.
steps.changed: The other two layouts are gone. The word 'Preview' above the picture is removed, as you asked.
steps.notice: The heart, star and share now sit beside the chips, one line under the name, so the name no longer breaks mid-word.
steps.risk: The chips are cut short in the narrow column.

steps.path: Marketplace → Themes → Cotton Candy Sky (not installed)
steps.headline: The same page for a theme you don't have: the picture left, Install at the top of the right column.
steps.changed: Same as above for the not-installed state.
steps.notice: Install is full width in the right-hand card.
